title: Published my game on playstore
author: No_Age4655
selftext:
Finally got my game published on Play Store, didn't realize how much hurdles and waiting periods there would be publishing on play console.

Now its published I'm not sure what's next, maybe make something else or work on the current game

Anyone have any success stories publishing and making money on games created with AI?

Here's my game: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.circuitflow.game

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body:
I think you're better off at some other platforms, like WebGL. I put a very good and popular game on the Play Store and it got like no views. 

Only works if you have a large audience.

comments.author: Uncle___Marty
comments.body:
Downloaded and played for a bit and left a review for you :) As this sub is all about struggling devs who use AI to achieve their dreams I think it would be cool if this becomes a standard on this sub if its not against the rules? replies.author: No_Age4655

replies.author: Uncle___Marty
replies.body:
You're MOST welcome, game is solid and if you can market it then you could have a nice, tidy little income from it :) My game is a LONG way off being ready (started it a couple months ago and the complexity of the project is pretty fierce) and I would hope when its ready and I make a post here I could get at least a couple of downloads and reviews ;)

As to answer your question I would ask a frontier model how you can easily market your game and get coverage. I already did this with an AI and its answer was great but its sounds boring AF lol.

replies.author: No_Age4655
replies.body:
Thanks so much,  I plan on hopefully getting a stable little income from this hopefully :).

comments.author: Coriseo
comments.body: I'm going to give you a piece of advice for this game and any others you plan on making in the future using AI: a lot of people who use AI focus heavily on gameplay and completely forget about the menu details and text. AI tends to make interactive menus very simple and always uses the same font unless you explicitly specify otherwise. Honestly, I've already seen your game's menu, logos, and typography in other generic AI-made games, so focus on improving those areas if you don't want your game to look just like the rest.

replies.author: No_Age4655
replies.body: Thank you, I 100% agree and its something I should have changed before putting it out there. This will be one of my first changes for the next update so thank you 🙏
